summary.title: SecureNova AI Identity Thread Model
summary.description: SecureNova is an AI platform containing human users, AI agents, OAuth M2M clients, LLM APIs, RAG pipeline services, MCP servers, and internal APIs. This threat model analyzes identity, authentication, authorization, trust boundaries, and AI-specific security threats using STRIDE.
